title: Set the default file manager
summary: Use xdg-mime to set a specific application as the default file manager for opening directories.
prerequisites: Know the .desktop file name of your file manager (e.g., thunar.desktop)

steps.explain: Set the default application for opening directories (inode/directory). Replace <FM_DESKTOP> with the .desktop file name of your file manager.

placeholders.name: FM_DESKTOP
placeholders.description: The .desktop file name of the file manager.
